source_documents: Source snapshots and full marked articles retain the cited text and bibliography entries.

marking_optimization.validation: Each reviewed marking group has one enclosing box. All 108 packet pages match their full-article pages in text, dimensions, marking boxes and rendering; repeated optimization requires no changes.

occurrence_audit.scope: Every page of the 21 complete articles: word-level matching of TQT/TQTs, Jain, the TQT titles (singular, plural and across hyphenated line breaks), the arXiv identifiers and numbered citations, including grouped citations and bracket ranges, and OCR of all pages at 220 dpi for text drawn as graphics, which is enforced through reviewed rectangles. Articles 02, 05, 07, 10, 12, 16, 17, 18 and 19 also have source-page and 300 dpi OCR review; boxes for articles 01, 03, 04, 06, 08, 09, 11, 13, 14, 15, 20 and 21 are generated sentence and table-row groups with visual review.

source_evidence_scope: All 388 retained files under Sources preserve their captured hashes. Archived retrieval and profile totals describe the saved source snapshot.

report_split.article_numbering: Articles 01–21 are numbered in ranked order; the marked files and the packet use the same numbers.
report_split.validation: The report and the marked packet follow the article numbers. All 108 packet pages match full-article text, dimensions, marking boxes and rendering.

selection.screening: Full texts of 265 citing works screened for TQT body discussion; candidates read in context. The screening outputs and the paper-by-paper review ledger are kept outside the published package.
selection.ranking: Articles are numbered by the documented use of TQT: adoption, implementation or extension in the citing work’s own methods or experiments (01–11), comparison, credit or a single-sentence use (12–15), and citation without reported use or use through a modified implementation or vendor toolchain (16–21); depth of reliance, venue standing and independence order each group.
selection.zero_count_records: Articles 14 and 20: the saved Scholar records carry no cited-by link; reported as no count shown.

affiliation_sources.scope: Affiliations of Scholar-catalogued works, including previews and citation-version discrepancies identified in the review ledger; not a census of independently verified TQT adoption. RAPQ remains excluded from the retained inventory pending the applicant's decision; 337 is the archived record count, not the retained unique-record count.
